suppress.notes:
False positive. CVE-2026-42582 is a QPACK header-length allocation bug in io.netty.handler.codec.http3.QpackDecoder. It affects netty 4.2.0 through 4.2.12 and is fixed in 4.2.13.Final.
This project is on the 4.1 line (4.1.137.Final, pinned in pom.xml), which is outside the affected range. The vulnerable class ships in netty-codec-http3, an HTTP/3 module that exists only in 4.2.x and is not in the dependency tree. Dependency Check matches it anyway through the generic cpe:2.3:a:netty:netty:4.1.137 CPE, which does not distinguish netty artifacts from one another.
Scoped to 4.1.x on purpose. If netty ever moves to 4.2.x this suppression stops matching, so a genuine exposure would fail the build rather than stay hidden.
Review date: 2027-03-09
